privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content_html:
Morocco Extra Tours is committed to safeguarding your personal information. Please review this Privacy Policy (“Policy”) to understand how we collect, use, and protect your data. By using our website or services, you consent to the practices described in this Policy. If you do not agree with these terms, please refrain from using our services.

For questions regarding this Policy, contact us at: contact@moroccoextratours.com

1. Why We Collect Personal Information

To deliver our travel services—such as organizing and managing bookings—we must collect, use, and sometimes disclose personal information. Morocco Extra Tours protects this information through physical, electronic, and procedural security measures.

Under the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”), Morocco Extra Tours may act as either the data controller or data processor, depending on the nature of the service provided.

  • For all retail travel services and marketing activities, Morocco Extra Tours is the data controller, and this Policy applies fully.

By providing your personal information, you agree that this Policy governs how we handle your data and you consent to its collection, use, and disclosure as described. If you do not agree, please do not provide us with your information.

Failure to provide required information—or withdrawing your consent—may limit our ability to deliver services to you.

2. Personal Information We Collect

Personal information, as defined under GDPR and Moroccan data protection laws, includes data necessary to arrange and manage your travel. We may collect:

  • Full name, address, and contact details
  • Passport information
  • Payment information (credit/debit card details)
  • Dietary requirements
  • Medical or accessibility information (if applicable)

We may also collect data for promotions, competitions, or general inquiries.

In some cases, we may need to collect sensitive information (such as health details), but only with your explicit consent and only when required.

3. How We Collect Personal Information

We collect information in accordance with data protection laws, typically from what you provide directly during your interactions with us. This occurs when you:

  • Contact us in person, by phone, email, or online
  • Visit our website
  • Communicate with us on social media
  • Make a booking or travel inquiry
  • Register for promotions or competitions
  • Subscribe to newsletters or marketing
  • Request brochures or travel details

We may also receive information from third parties—such as when someone makes a booking on your behalf.

4. How We Use Your Personal Information

We process your data based on:

  • Your consent
  • The necessity to provide requested services
  • Legal compliance
  • Our legitimate business interests

Examples of how we use your information:

  • To provide travel advice and make travel arrangements
  • To process payments and manage bookings
  • For marketing, service improvement, and internal research
  • To comply with regulatory and legal requirements

5. Disclosure of Personal Information

We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information.

We only share your data with trusted third parties as necessary for our business operations, including:

  • Hotels
  • Transport providers
  • Activity operators
  • IT service providers
  • Payment processors
  • Travel partners and contractors

All disclosures are made in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

6. International Transfers of Personal Information

Your information may be transferred to service providers abroad, such as:

  • Overseas hotels
  • International travel operators
  • Third-party booking and reservation systems

These transfers are conducted in compliance with GDPR and other applicable laws, ensuring adequate protection of your data.

7. Your Rights Under GDPR

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal information
  • Correct or update inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your information
  • Restrict or object to processing
  • Request a copy of your data in a portable format (data portability)

To exercise these rights, contact us at:
contact@moroccoextratours.com

We will respond within one month in accordance with GDPR requirements.

8. Information Security

Morocco Extra Tours employs multiple security measures to safeguard personal information from:

  • Loss
  • Misuse
  • Unauthorized access
  • Alteration
  • Disclosure

We regularly review and update our security practices to ensure maximum protection.

9. Social Media Integrations

Our website or mobile applications may use third-party social media tools. These features may collect:

  • your IP address
  • pages you visit
  • interactions with social media widgets

Your interactions are governed by the privacy policies of the respective social media platforms.

10. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and tracking technologies to:

  • Improve website functionality
  • Analyze user behavior
  • Deliver a better browsing experience
  • Enable targeted advertising (via third-party vendors)

You may disable cookies in your browser settings or opt out of targeted ads via the Network Advertising Initiative opt-out page.

11. Feedback & Contact

To request:

  • Corrections
  • Copies
  • Deletions
  • Restrictions on use

Please email us at:
contact@moroccoextratours.com

For general questions, comments, or complaints, you may also contact your assigned travel consultant or our Privacy Officer.

12. Changes to This Policy

Morocco Extra Tours may modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Updated versions will be posted on our website with the revision date. Your continued use of the website or our services constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

We will notify users of significant changes via online notice.

Contact Details

Email: contact@moroccoextratours.com
Address: Complexe comercial Al omran 32 ait ourir Marrakech, Morocco 42000
Company Number: 003310434000096

Last Updated: 03/24/2026

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.content_html:
By booking a tour with Morocco Extra Tours, you accept these Terms & Conditions on behalf of yourself and all other participants included in your reservation. Once you agree to all details of the proposal, Morocco Extra Tours will issue an invoice containing payment instructions. Your booking will be confirmed upon receipt of a 20% to 30% deposit of the total invoice amount. The remaining balance may be paid in cash on the day of the tour.

Booking Changes & Cancellations

If changes to your booking cannot be made for any reason, you may continue with your original travel arrangements or cancel based on the cancellation terms below.
If you need to cancel your trip, please notify us in writing as soon as possible. Cancellation fees are calculated from the date we receive your written cancellation notice:

    • 30 days or more before the tour start date: Only the deposit is retained.

    • Less than 30 days before the start date: No refund is possible (full payment required).

We cannot accept liability for any loss, damage, or additional expenses—and no refunds will be issued—if your holiday is affected by events outside our control. These include, but are not limited to: war, threat of war, civil unrest, airport closures, industrial action, terrorism or threat of terrorism, natural disasters, or any situation classified by the Commonwealth and Foreign Office (UK) as unsafe for travel.

Special Requirements

Please inform us before confirming your booking if you have any special requirements, such as dietary restrictions, medical needs, mobility assistance, or other conditions. We will share this information with our suppliers to ensure a comfortable and safe experience.

Any preferences (such as hotel location or bed configuration) should be indicated at the time of booking. While we will do our best to meet your requests, we cannot guarantee fulfillment, and no compensation will be provided if specific preferences cannot be arranged.

Transportation

All vehicles used by Morocco Extra Tours are fully insured and licensed as tourist transport, authorized to carry the appropriate number of passengers.

Travel Insurance

All participants must have suitable and adequate travel insurance covering:

    • Personal belongings (including money and passport)

    • Personal accident or injury

    • Medical expenses and repatriation

    • Emergency medical or air ambulance services (minimum medical/repatriation cover of €5,000)

We strongly recommend adding cancellation insurance.
Please ensure your policy covers activities such as camel riding, horse riding, trekking, quad biking, and other excursions that may take place over rough terrain or at altitudes above 2,000 meters.

Liability

Morocco Extra Tours assumes no responsibility for personal injury, illness, death, accident, damage, or loss incurred during your trip. We act solely as an agent and are not liable for the actions of third-party service providers, including carriers, accommodation providers, guides, activity organizers, and transportation companies.

We are not responsible for circumstances beyond our reasonable control or for issues that occur without fault on the part of Morocco Extra Tours. Note that safety and operational standards of local suppliers may differ from those in your home country.

Itinerary Changes

All elements of your itinerary are subject to change due to conditions beyond our control—such as weather, road closures, mechanical issues, or driver health. Morocco Extra Tours reserves the right to make last-minute itinerary adjustments when necessary. The driver or guide may make real-time logistical decisions based on local conditions and professional judgment.

While we strive to ensure you reach your onward travel connections on time, delays can occur. We strongly recommend scheduling onward travel no earlier than the day following the end of your tour.

Cycling & Safety Equipment

For cycling activities, please note that the availability and quality of protective headgear may vary. We cannot guarantee that helmets provided locally will meet your country’s safety standards. We recommend bringing your own equipment if required.

Travel Documents

Please ensure you have all necessary travel documents before arriving in Morocco:

    • A valid passport (valid through your return date and containing a blank page for the entry stamp)

    • A confirmed return/onward ticket

    • Any required visas based on your nationality

It is your responsibility to confirm and comply with all passport and visa requirements. Morocco Extra Tours is not liable for missed holidays or repatriation costs resulting from failure to meet entry requirements.

Privacy & Use of Information

We are committed to safeguarding your private and confidential information. Personal data collected during booking will be used solely for arranging reservations with hotels, transport providers, and other suppliers. Your special requirements will only be shared with relevant parties to ensure a safe and enjoyable experience.

Morocco Extra Tours may use photographs or case studies from your tour on our website and social media platforms for promotional purposes. If you prefer not to be featured, please inform us at the time of booking.

Complaints

If you encounter any issues during your tour, please inform your driver, guide, or accommodation provider immediately so they can attempt to resolve the matter.
If the issue cannot be resolved locally, contact our office with full details of your complaint. Addressing concerns while you are on the tour gives us the best chance to fix any problems.

We want your visit to Morocco to be enjoyable and will make every effort to ensure your satisfaction.
